interface.signature: findSwapValues(A: List[int], B: List[int], N: int, M: int) -> int

preconditions.expression: isinstance(A, list) and all(isinstance(x, int) for x in A)
preconditions.description: A is a list of integers.

preconditions.expression: isinstance(B, list) and all(isinstance(x, int) for x in B)
preconditions.description: B is a list of integers.
N is an integer and equals the length of A.
M is an integer and equals the length of B.

postconditions.description: The return value is either 1 or -1.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 1 if any(a in set(B) and (sum(A) - a + b == sum(B) - b + a) for a in A for b in B) else return_value == -1
postconditions.description: The return value is 1 if there exists a pair (a, b) such that swapping a from A and b from B makes the sums of A and B equal; otherwise, it is -1.
